❓ How do you regulate innovations that are so innovative, they don't fit in with current regulatory frameworks? That's the question at the heart of a session we're running at European Health Forum Gastein on 2 October.

💡 Moderated by IHI's Niklas Blomberg, the session will explore how regulatory sandboxes can offer a space for structured regulatory experimentation.
